$schema_note: Where each Mid-Atlantic jurisdiction's property/sales records actually live, with URL patterns and machine-access status. wired = live comps provider; discovery = provider staged, endpoint resolving via /api/comps/health; manual = human-usable portal, no clean API found; unassessed = not yet investigated.

sources.system: OTR ITS Public Extract + property sales (Open Data DC, ArcGIS)
sources.url_pattern: https://opendata.dc.gov/datasets/integrated-tax-system-public-extract-property-sales — ArcGIS FeatureServer query; per-parcel human lookup at https://mytax.dc.gov (Real Property search by SSL)
sources.access: wired (dc_its; field names pending health check)
sources.notes: CAMA Residential/Commercial/Condo datasets carry building characteristics; daily updates.

sources.system: SDAT Real Property via Maryland Open Data (Socrata ed4q-f8tm)
sources.url_pattern: https://opendata.maryland.gov/resource/ed4q-f8tm.json?$where=... — SoQL incl. within_circle; per-parcel human lookup at https://sdat.dat.maryland.gov/RealProperty/
sources.access: wired (md_sdat; column names pending health check)
sources.notes: One feed covers PG, Montgomery, Baltimore City/County, and every other MD county.

sources.system: OPA properties + assessment history (Carto SQL API)
sources.url_pattern: https://phl.carto.com/api/v2/sql?q=SELECT ... FROM opa_properties_public — PostGIS SQL; per-parcel human lookup at https://property.phila.gov/?p=<parcel_number>
sources.notes: RTT transfer records also exposed (rtt_summary table) for deed-level history.

sources.url_pattern: https://services2.arcgis.com/XVOqAjTOJ5P6ngMu/arcgis/rest/services/Parcels_Composite_NJ_WM/FeatureServer/0/query — current service (pre-2026-03-11 URL retired); county tax-board SR1A sales files supplement
sources.access: wired (nj_modiv; MOD-IV column names pending health check)
sources.notes: MOD-IV = the assessor tax roll joined to parcels; NJ municipal rent-control screen is the separate regulatory gap.

sources.system: Tax Administration Real Estate — sales + parcels (ArcGIS hub)
sources.url_pattern: https://data-fairfaxcountygis.opendata.arcgis.com/datasets/Fairfaxcountygis::tax-administrations-real-estate-sales-data/about — sales is a coordinate-less TABLE with one-to-many join to parcels; per-parcel human lookup at https://icare.fairfaxcounty.gov/
sources.notes: Wiring needs the backing FeatureServer URL from the hub v3 probe + a two-stage parcel join.

sources.url_pattern: https://gisdata-arlgis.opendata.arcgis.com/ — property polygons w/ assessment attributes; per-parcel human lookup at https://propertysearch.arlingtonva.us/
sources.notes: Server root probe (gis.arlingtonva.us) lists services; sales attribute names unknown.

sources.url_pattern: https://www.pwcva.gov/department/real-estate-assessments — human search; GIS at https://gisweb.pwcgov.org; no documented open sales API found
sources.notes: Portal 403-blocks automated fetch (confirmed July 2026); the county TAX-DELINQUENCY list (verified pipeline, July pass) is the off-market flow source.
Socrata portal historically carries property + transfer datasets — likely wireable; next candidate after the VA discovery pair.

sources.url_pattern: https://data.norfolk.gov (Socrata) / https://data.vbgov.com — assessor human search per city
sources.notes: Both cities run Socrata portals; sales datasets unconfirmed.

sources.system: Covered by statewide SDAT feed; city open data supplements
sources.url_pattern: https://data.baltimorecity.gov — vacants, permits, citations (useful for the license/violation screen)
sources.notes: City code-violation data pairs with the rent-freeze-while-unabated rule.

sources.url_pattern: https://data.wprdc.org/api/3/action/datastore_search_sql?sql=SELECT ... FROM "5bbe6c55-bce6-4edb-9d04-68edeb6bf7b1" — sales lack coordinates; join to parcel centroids resource or tools.wprdc.org/property-api
sources.notes: Best-documented civic data portal in PA; monthly refresh.

sources.url_pattern: varies; e.g. https://www.montgomerycountypa.gov (GIS hub), Bucks/Chester ArcGIS hubs
https://www3.newcastlede.gov/parcel/search/ (human) / https://apps-nccde.hub.arcgis.com (hub); REST root probe at gis.nccde.org
sources.notes: Kent/Sussex counties: no open feeds found — Delaware outside NCC is a manual-lookup state.
